source.title: Goldsmith TourData.lua: original account milling/prospecting aggregate copied into demonstration snapshot
source.author: sunseteffect

notes: HELD for unconditional cast EV and occurrence. Published anonymized demonstration snapshot derived from a real account as described by its generator; the selected milling table is deep-copied unchanged, and the original Oct 13 publication has identical rows. One aggregate per exact input from the same account, not independent participants. Raw milled=228 is the sum of positive bag decreases, potentially net of refunds and susceptible to timing; raw perCast=5; raw qty=10 is positive bag gain within 3 seconds, not an authoritative loot receipt. Do not put the milled value in inputsProcessed or divide it by batch: no completed-cast ledger, actual gross inputs, refunds, hits, zeros, histogram, unlock allocation, capstone, skill, build, exact capture date or independent overlap verification. Profession field Jewelcrafting. No implied zeros for omitted outputs. Source generator https://github.com/sunseteffect/Goldsmith/blob/7bb423773226e59e16592253d9227473f43b51e1/Tools/Make-TourData.lua#L471-L482; historical collector https://github.com/sunseteffect/Goldsmith/blob/7bb423773226e59e16592253d9227473f43b51e1/Milling.lua; exact rank crosswalk https://github.com/bughatti/voidprof/blob/7386e873a775126273f706ba6dfacd36dd700aa0/ProfessionData.lua (header says quality IDs lowest first, build is catalogue only, not study build). Gem rarity/flawless names are not inferred craft quality ranks. Preserve raw totals only; do not convert bag-delta denominator into an operation mean.
